import json, subprocess, sys, work

p={"defaults":{"b":True,"i":3,"s":"x"},"types":{"b":"boolean","i":"integer","s":"string"},"null_resets":True,"environment":True}
cases=[
({"layers":[{"b":False},{"i":0,"s":""}]},{"ok":True,"config":{"b":False,"i":0,"s":""},"error":None}),
({"layers":[{"i":None}]},{"ok":True,"config":{"b":True,"i":3,"s":"x"},"error":None}),
({"layers":[{"x":1}]},{"ok":False,"config":{},"error":"unknown_key"}),
({"layers":[{"i":True}]},{"ok":False,"config":{},"error":"type"}),
({"environment":{"b":"false","i":"-12","s":""}},{"ok":True,"config":{"b":False,"i":-12,"s":""},"error":None}),
({"environment":{"b":"False"}},{"ok":False,"config":{},"error":"environment"}),
({"environment":{"i":" 1"}},{"ok":False,"config":{},"error":"environment"}),
({"environment":{"x":"1"}},{"ok":False,"config":{},"error":"unknown_key"})]
for req, expected in cases: assert work.evaluate(req,p)==expected,(req,work.evaluate(req,p),expected)
assert work.evaluate({"layers":[{"s":None}]},dict(p,null_resets=False))["error"]=="type"
assert work.evaluate({"environment":{"i":"1"}},dict(p,environment=False))["error"]=="environment"
subprocess.run([sys.executable,"work.py"],check=True)
with open("policy.json",encoding="utf-8") as f: policy=json.load(f)
with open("requests.json",encoding="utf-8") as f: requests=json.load(f)
with open("report.json",encoding="utf-8") as f: report=json.load(f)
assert report==[work.evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]
subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-m","py_compile","work.py"],check=True)
print("stage 3 checks passed")
